# unifi_network_traffic_route (Resource)

A UniFi traffic route (v2 `trafficroutes`) — policy routing: send traffic matched by destination (domains, IPs, regions, or the whole internet) out a specific interface/VPN (`network_id`) for a set of target devices, with an optional kill switch.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `matching_target` (String) What the route matches on: `INTERNET` (all), `DOMAIN`, `IP`, or `REGION`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `domains` (Set of String) Domains to match when `matching_target = DOMAIN`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `ip_addresses` (Set of String) IP addresses to match when `matching_target = IP`.
- `ip_ranges` (Set of String) IP ranges/CIDRs to match when `matching_target = IP`.
- `kill_switch_enabled` (Boolean) When the egress is down, drop matched traffic instead of falling back to the default route. Defaults to `false`.
- `network_id` (String) The interface or VPN network the matched traffic is routed through (the route's egress).
- `regions` (Set of String) Region codes to match when `matching_target = REGION`.
- `target_devices` (Attributes List) Which devices the rule applies to. Each entry is all clients, a specific client (by MAC), or a whole network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_devices))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.

<a id="nestedatt--target_devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target_devices`

Required:

- `type` (String) Target kind: `ALL_CLIENTS`, `CLIENT` (set `client_mac`), or `NETWORK` (set `network_id`).

Optional:

- `client_mac` (String) Client MAC, when `type = CLIENT`.
- `network_id` (String) Network id, when `type = NETWORK`.
